description: This file contains abstract and concrete grain classes for testing placement strategies in Orleans, including methods for managing grain activation, retrieving endpoints, and simulating overload conditions. It also includes grains for local content and test content, with various placement attributes and utility methods.

classes.name: PlacementTestGrainBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for placement test grains, providing common functionality for managing endpoints, overload detection, and environment statistics.

classes.name: RandomPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Grain with RandomPlacement attribute, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Grain with PreferLocalPlacement attribute, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Stateless worker grain with a limit of 1, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: OtherStatelessWorkerPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Stateless worker grain with a limit of 2, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Grain with ActivationCountBasedPlacement attribute, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: DefaultPlacementGrain
classes.description: Grain that retrieves its default placement strategy.

classes.name: LocalContentGrain
classes.description: Grain activated on each silo by bootstrap provider, caches silo identity, and provides content.

classes.name: TestContentGrain
classes.description: Grain that fetches and logs its runtime identity and content from LocalContentGrain.

methods.name: GetEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint of the grain's silo.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime instance ID.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the unique activation ID.

methods.name: Nop
methods.description: A no-operation method.

methods.name: StartLocalGrains
methods.description: Starts multiple local grains given a list of keys.

methods.name: StartPreferLocalGrain
methods.description: Starts a specific grain with a preferred local placement.

methods.name: SampleLocalGrainEndpoint
methods.description: Samples endpoints from a grain multiple times.

methods.name: SampleLocalGrainEndpoint (overload)
methods.description: Samples endpoints for a specific grain key.

methods.name: PropagateStatisticsToCluster
methods.description: Forces propagation of environment statistics across the cluster.

methods.name: EnableOverloadDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables overload detection.

methods.name: LatchOverloaded
methods.description: Simulates an overloaded environment by latch statistics.

methods.name: UnlatchOverloaded
methods.description: Resets overload latch statistics.

methods.name: LatchCpuUsage
methods.description: Simulates high CPU usage.

methods.name: UnlatchCpuUsage
methods.description: Resets CPU usage latch.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Returns the silo address where the grain is located.

methods.name: GetWorkerLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of local workers for stateless worker grains.

methods.name: GetDefaultPlacement
methods.description: Retrieves the default placement strategy for the grain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, caches silo identity.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the LocalContentGrain.

methods.name: GetContent
methods.description: Returns cached silo identity content.

methods.name: FetchContentFromLocalGrain
methods.description: Fetches content from the local content grain.
